title: AdaS-ViT: Test-Time Adaptive Routing for Spiking Vision Transformers with Ultra-High Energy Efficiency
abstract: arXiv:2611.23728v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) promise event-driven and energy-efficient vision, yet existing spiking vision transformers (S-ViTs) largely confine spiking tokens to fixed and uniform firing schemes along the temporal, spatial and channel dimensions, whereas suppressing the computational redundancy thus incurred calls for adaptive firing mechanisms that operate jointly across all three axes at test time. To this end, we propose the Adaptive Efficient Integrate-and-Fire (AdaE-IF) model, which consults the attention score of each spiking token and routes salient regions to fine-grained firing patterns while assigning energy-frugal coarse patterns to the remaining regions. Building on AdaE-IF, we further introduce Spiking Gated Self-Attention (S-GSA) and Spiking Local-Gated Unit (S-LGU), which enforce selective spike emission at token and channel granularity. translated_title: AdaS-ViT：具有超高能效的脉冲视觉Transformer测试时自适应路由
translated_abstract: 脉冲神经网络有望实现事件驱动且节能的视觉处理，然而现有的脉冲视觉Transformer在很大程度上将脉冲token限制在时间、空间和通道维度上固定且统一的发放方案中，而抑制由此产生的计算冗余需要在测试时能够跨这三个维度联合运作的自适应发放机制。为此，我们提出了自适应高效积分发放模型，该模型参考每个脉冲token的注意力分数，将显著区域路由到细粒度的发放模式，同时为其余区域分配节能的粗粒度模式。在AdaE-IF的基础上，我们进一步引入了脉冲门控自注意力和脉冲局部门控单元，它们在token和通道粒度上强制实现选择性脉冲发放。我们将上述机制和模块集成到AdaS-ViT中，这是一种测试时…
tldr: 该论文提出AdaS-ViT，通过AdaE-IF、S-GSA和S-LGU等机制在测试时于时间、空间和通道三个维度上实现自适应脉冲发放路由，从而大幅提升脉冲视觉Transformer的能量效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AdaS-ViT, which achieves test-time adaptive spike firing routing across temporal, spatial, and channel dimensions through mechanisms including AdaE-IF, S-GSA, and S-LGU, thereby greatly improving the energy efficiency of spiking vision transformers.
